picks.title: Thermodynamics of NaCl(aq) from 230 to 2000 K and from 0.1 to 10,000 MPa: Applications to Earth and Other Ocean Worlds
picks.abstract: We present a new Gibbs energy representation for aqueous NaCl, based on new sound speed and phase equilibrium measurements, using local basis functions. Throughout, NaCl(aq) denotes the bulk aqueous component—the sum of NaCl 0 , Na + and Cl − —rather than the neutral complex, with the degree of dissociation implicit in the measurements rather than imposed. This comprehensive equation of state, valid for pressures to 10 000 M P a , temperatures from 230 K to 2000 K , and molality to 7 m o l k g − 1 , allows us to address chemical processes within Earth and interior structure and evolution of large icy moons with possible oceans. The region below 500 M P a at temperatures above 500 K , which contains water’s saturation curve and critical point, is excluded for want of constraining measurements; within the domain represented the fluid is a single phase. In regimes unconstrained by data, it assumes near-gas behavior at high temperatures and volume mixing of water and salt at extreme pressures. Differentiation of the representation yields all equilibrium properties, including volumes, specific heat capacities, and chemical potentials. The model is validated by its accurate prediction of ice Ih and VI melting and brucite dehydration in saline solutions, and by its reproduction of antigorite dehydration in pure water through two changes in reaction product to beyond 6000 M P a . We describe three applications of the Gibbs energy representation. (1) The depth during subduction of the antigorite dehydration reaction in the presence of saline geofluids is estimated to be reduced by 2 k m to 4 k m per mole of NaCl in solution, substantially less than the up to 10 k m per mole implied by previously inferred pressure-dependent water activities. (2) A H 2 O − NaCl phase diagram to 1000 M P a and 230 K to 400 K identifies the pressure-variant eutectics for hydrohalite and disodium chloride decaheptahydrate, and places the cenotectic—the absolute limit of liquid stability—at 205 M P a , 235 K and 3.90 m o l k g − 1 , where the liquid coexists with ice Ih, ice II and disodium chloride decaheptahydrate rather than with hydrohalite. (3) Icy moons: structural models of Ganymede, Callisto, and two Titan cases with 1.90 m o l k g − 1 aqueous NaCl show that melting point suppression stabilizes ices II, III, V, and VI, and that ices II and III can be buoyant in the coexisting fluid, with the sense of the ice II contrast reversing between 50 and 100 g k g − 1 . The resulting co-occurrence of ices II and III, not previously reported, admits multiphase overturning and implies that salinity governs the geodynamics of these > 100 k m lithospheres. Finally, we set out how a bulk Gibbs energy surface interfaces with species-based frameworks such as HKF and the Deep Earth Water model, and propose that the pressure derivative of the surface can be used to constrain the degree of association at high pressure.
picks.summary_ja: NaCl水溶液について、新たな音速・相平衡測定に基づくギブズエネルギー表現を提示している。適用範囲は230〜2000 K、0.1〜10,000 MPa、モル濃度7 mol/kgまでである。氷Ihおよび氷VIの融解、ブルーサイトの脱水、反ちがい石の脱水などの予測で検証されたとしている。地球内部の化学過程や、海を持つ可能性のある大型氷衛星の内部構造・進化への応用が述べられている。
picks.why: 氷衛星の内部海・氷殻を扱う際の基礎となる塩水の状態方程式であり、読者の関心に直結する。

picks.title: Oued Chebeika 002 at the nanoscale: microstructures, composition and comparison with CI-like materials
picks.abstract: Oued Chebeika 002, a CI (Ivuna-type) carbonaceous chondrite recovered in the Moroccan desert in 2024, represents one of the rarest and most pristine samples available to investigate early Solar System processes. In this study, we present a comprehensive nanoscale characterization of the main components of Oued Chebeika 002 (i.e. phyllosilicates, sulfides, magnetite, and carbonates) using transmission electron microscopy, with the aim of resolving its submicrometric mineralogical heterogeneity, constraining the physicochemical conditions of aqueous alteration on its parent body, and comparing these features with those observed in other CI chondrites and samples returned from asteroids Ryugu and Bennu. Our observations reveal a complex mineral assemblage dominated by phyllosilicates intimately associated with Fe-sulfides, magnetite, and carbonates. Overall, the mineral assemblage closely resembles those of CI chondrites and samples from Ryugu and Bennu, suggesting that aqueous alteration processes were broadly similar across their parent body(ies). In particular, the occurrence of dolomite is consistent with precipitation from brines, while its compositional zoning and complex microstructures, including mottled and ribbon-like textures, suggest formation through metastable precursors and subsequent dissolution–reprecipitation and re-equilibration processes. Magnetite spherulites and spherules likewise record distinct non-equilibrium processes. The former is characterized by a radiating microstructure and likely formed through a non-classical crystallization pathway from supersaturated solutions, whereas the latter displays surface etch pits indicative of dissolution. Taken together, the microstructural characteristics of both carbonate and magnetite are indicative of formation and alteration under dynamic, non-equilibrium conditions, highlighting the evolving nature of aqueous solutions in CI parent body(ies).
picks.summary_ja: 2024年にモロッコで回収されたCI(イヴナ型)炭素質コンドライト Oued Chebeika 002 を透過型電子顕微鏡でナノスケール解析している。フィロケイ酸塩、硫化物、マグネタイト、炭酸塩が密接に共存する鉱物組合せで、他のCIコンドライトやリュウグウ・ベンヌ試料と類似するとしている。ドロマイトはブラインからの沈殿と整合的で、累帯構造や複雑な微細組織は準安定前駆体を経た溶解・再沈殿を示唆するという。マグネタイトのスフェルライトや球状粒子も非平衡過程を記録しているとされる。
picks.why: 水質変成を受けた始原的隕石で、リュウグウ・ベンヌ試料との比較があり、アストロバイオロジー関連の有機物・水環境研究に近い。

picks.title: Morphology and dynamics of steep-fronted glaciers around Alba Mons, Mars
picks.abstract: Martian ice-rich landforms, generically referred to as Viscous Flow Features (VFFs), are key to understanding the Late Amazonian climate history of Mars, as its evolution may be recorded in the internal structure and dynamics of these deposits. In this study, we report the occurrence of 29 steep-fronted, pole-facing lobate deposits identified within craters (24) and pits (5) larger than 2 km in diameter in the Alba Mons region of Mars. We interpret these deposits, which extend 1-3 km downslope and can reach thicknesses exceeding 200 m at their termini, as debris-covered glaciers. Their most distinctive feature is a steep (up to 42°) terminal scarp, tens to hundreds of meters high, which truncates surface flow features. This morphology has not been previously described for Martian debris covered glaciers, but resembles the steep termini of some debris-covered or rock glaciers on Earth. We propose that these steep-fronts result from sublimation-driven retreat of ice at the glacier termini. The steep fronts exhibit two superposed textural units. We argue that these do not reflect internal layering, but instead correspond to distinct components of the glacier system: a lower, rougher and steeper unit that we interpret as a debris accumulation (moraine-like), and an upper, smoother unit corresponding to the ice-rich body of the glacier. This debris accumulation is likely sourced from the degraded crater headwalls and transported by the flowing glacier before accumulating at the front as ice sublimates. Finally, our comparison with a debris-covered glacier in northern Iceland reveals similar frontal morphologies, supporting the interpretation of the two textural units of the Martian deposits. Combined with glacial flow model and climate model outputs, our results suggest that these deposits represent the remnants of ice deposits formed during a recent colder, high-obliquity period and preserved under favorable topographic conditions on pole-facing crater slopes. Although their present-day geometry indicates a state of disequilibrium, characterized by mass deficits in the distal regions and excess ice in the source areas, our results show that their distinctive steep-fronted morphology arises from the combined effects of ice flow and sublimation-driven marginal ablation. These findings underscore the critical roles of local topography and debris-ice interactions in governing the preservation, evolution, and geomorphic expression of ice-rich deposits on Mars.
picks.summary_ja: アルバ・モンス周辺で、直径2 km超のクレーターやピット内に見られる急峻な前面を持つ極向きのローブ状堆積物29例を報告している。これらは岩屑被覆氷河と解釈され、長さ1〜3 km、末端の厚さは200 m超に達する。最大42°の末端崖が特徴で、氷河末端での昇華による後退で形成されたと提案している。前面は2つの組織ユニットからなり、下部はモレーン状の岩屑集積、上部は氷に富む本体と解釈している。
picks.why: 火星の後期アマゾニアン氷河・水氷の分布と気候史に関わる地質研究である。

picks.title: The influence of a long-lived basal magma ocean on the coupled core-mantle evolution of Mars
picks.abstract: Recent seismic observations suggest the presence of a basal molten layer above the Martian core that may represent a long-lived basal magma ocean (BMO). However, its influence on the coupled thermal evolution of the Martian mantle and core remains poorly understood. Here, we employ a two-dimensional mantle convection model coupled with parameterized thermal evolution models for the core and BMO to investigate the long-term interior evolution of Mars. Our results show that a long-lived BMO modifies core-mantle thermal coupling by regulating heat exchange between the core and mantle and maintaining elevated temperatures in the lowermost mantle. In particular, enrichment of heat-producing elements (HPEs) within the BMO enhances deep interior heat retention, suppresses secular core cooling, inhibits inner-core growth, and promotes present-day mantle plume activity. We further find that reconciling a long-lived BMO with a present-day solid inner core requires both limited enrichment of HPEs within the BMO and relatively high core liquidus temperatures, which may be difficult to satisfy simultaneously. These results offer constraints on the thermal and magnetic evolution of Mars and highlight the importance of coupled mantle-BMO-core dynamics on Mars.
picks.summary_ja: 火星コア上の長寿命な基底マグマオーシャン(BMO)がマントルとコアの熱進化に与える影響を、2次元マントル対流モデルとパラメータ化したコア・BMOモデルで調べている。BMOは核とマントルの熱交換を調整し、最下部マントルの高温を維持するという。BMO内の熱生成元素の濃集は深部の熱保持を高め、コアの冷却や内核成長を抑え、現在のマントルプルーム活動を促進するとされる。現在の固体内核と両立させるには、熱生成元素の濃集が限定的でコアのリキダス温度が高い必要があるが、両立は難しいかもしれないと結論している。
picks.why: 火星内部構造と磁場進化に関する地震学観測を踏まえた理論研究で、火星の関心分野に合う。

picks.title: Boron isotope fractionation in siliceous hot spring sinters: Geochemical implications for biosignatures
picks.abstract: Siliceous hot spring sinters preserve coupled mineralogical, geochemical, and isotopic signatures generated during microbial silicification and therefore represent valuable archives of biosignature formation. However, the mechanistic criteria for distinguishing biologically influenced silicification from abiotic silica precipitation remain poorly constrained. Here we present paired boron-isotope and comprehensive multi-element datasets (up to 57 elements) for opaline silica sinters and coexisting waters from four hydrothermal systems spanning a wide range of physicochemical conditions (pH 2–8; 30–98 °C): the Taupo Volcanic Zone (New Zealand), Misasa (Japan), Puga (India), and El Tatio (Chile). Hydrothermal waters exhibit a relatively restricted range of δ 11 B values (≈ −5 to − 1‰, except Puga at ≈ −13‰), whereas associated silica sinters display much larger isotopic variability (≈ −10 to − 40‰), with in situ secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) analyses revealing microscale domains with values as low as − 50‰. Strongly negative δ 11 B values are systematically associated with boron enrichment (up to > 10,000 ppm), laminated microbial fabrics, and enrichments of multivalent and high-field-strength (HFS) cations. Stepwise leaching experiments and SIMS observations indicate that the measured boron-isotope signatures predominantly preserve primary depositional characteristics despite minor localized evaporative modification. To explain these coupled observations, we propose an EPS microenvironmental reactor model in which microbial activity within EPS-rich microenvironments generates localized physicochemical conditions distinct from those of bulk fluids. Within these microenvironments, local pH gradients associated with microbial activity promote the formation of tetrahedral borate, while EPS-associated multivalent and HFS cations facilitate boron retention during early opal-A polymerization. Progressive silica precipitation preferentially immobilizes isotopically light boron, producing strongly negative δ 11 B values together with characteristic multi-element enrichments. The model provides a mechanistic framework linking microbial activity, aqueous boron speciation, element partitioning, and silica precipitation, thereby accounting for the observed hierarchy of boron-isotope fractionation across geothermal systems spanning acidic to alkaline conditions. These findings indicate that opaline silica exhibiting δ 11 B ≤ − 20‰, together with boron enrichment, HFS-cation enrichment, and stromatolitic microfabrics, provides a powerful and testable geochemical criterion for biologically influenced silicification. Such negative δ 11 B values extend far beyond those of primary silicate reservoirs and, when coupled with complementary elemental and microstructural evidence, are consistent with biologically influenced boron sequestration during silica precipitation. The consistency of this signature across chemically diverse hydrothermal environments, together with its potential preservation in Paleoarchean hydrothermal deposits, suggests that boron isotopes offer a valuable tool for evaluating biosignatures in ancient terrestrial hydrothermal systems and silica-bearing environments, including Mars.
picks.summary_ja: ニュージーランド、三朝、プーガ、エル・タティオの4つの熱水系で、珪質温泉シンターと共存水のホウ素同位体と多元素組成(最大57元素)を報告している。水のδ11Bは狭い範囲(約−5〜−1‰、プーガは約−13‰)だが、シンターは約−10〜−40‰、SIMSでは最低−50‰に達する。強い負のδ11Bはホウ素濃集、層状の微生物組織、多価・高電界強度陽イオンの濃集と関連していた。段階的溶出実験などから、同位体シグナルは一次的な堆積時の特徴を主に保持していると示される。
picks.why: 微生物シリカ化の生命痕跡判別に関わり、火星の熱水堆積物探査などアストロバイオロジーに関連する。
